blocks.h2: Gas Line Projects in Hanover Park
blocks.intro: Common projects in homes from the '70s and '80s:

items.body: After storms like 2007, many homeowners want backup power. We run the gas line. An electrician handles the wiring.

blocks.body: A natural gas generator can keep your sump pump, furnace and refrigerator running for as long as the power is out, with no fuel to store. It needs a gas line sized for its load on top of everything already in the house, and sometimes a larger meter from Nicor. We size and run the gas line and pressure-test it. A licensed electrician handles the transfer switch and wiring. Plan ahead, before the next big storm.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a New Gas Line
blocks.body: The distance from the meter, the route and the size of the line matter most. A generator line can be larger and longer than a dryer line. Outdoor and underground runs take more work. We plan the route and quote one flat price.

blocks.h2: Gas Line Installation Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: Can you run a gas line for a standby generator?
items.answer: Yes. We size the line for the generator and everything else on the system.

items.q: Can my existing gas line handle a new appliance?
items.answer: We calculate the load and check the pipe before connecting.
Yes, where the village requires one.

items.q: Can you run gas to the patio?
items.answer: Yes, with a protected line and a shutoff.

items.q: Will a generator need a bigger gas meter?
items.answer: Sometimes. If the total load is too high for your meter, Nicor may need to upgrade it. We'll tell you after we add up the load.

items.q: Can you run gas to a garage heater?
items.answer: Yes, with a line sized for the heater and a shutoff nearby.

items.q: How much does gas line installation cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on the run. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the length of the run, the appliance and the route. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
